_about: Version of the built-in knowledge base, independent of the application version.
Bump this when the corpus content changes. It is stored per entry as kb_version and
shown in save_kb_versions, so a user can report which corpus they have.
The IDEMPOTENCE key is not this string but a SHA-256 over the merged corpus bytes.
Startup compares that checksum and does nothing when it matches, so forgetting to
bump the version still reloads correctly -- the version is for humans, the checksum
Everything else lives in the category directories beside this file. See README.md.
